product_summary: A local-first multi-agent software delivery operating system coordinating product, engineering, governance, founder mentorship, and go-to-market work across repositories.
problem_hypothesis: AI-assisted software work may be fragmented across repositories and specialist roles. Context loss, conflicting constraints, and rework are hypotheses to validate, not established customer facts.
target_users_hypothesis: Founders and engineering leaders managing multiple repositories. This segment has not yet been validated through customer interviews.
differentiators: GTM workflows and learning from verified outcomes
local-first operation with optional model integrations
constraints: Do not invent customers, interviews, traction, pricing, or validation.
Label facts, hypotheses, assumptions, and open questions separately.
Do not execute code changes, contact customers, send outreach, or publish content.
Treat approval as action-scoped; simulated approval is not real authorization.
Keep credentials, secrets, and personal data out of outputs and logs.
success_hypotheses: useful founder interventions tied to explicit goals
reduced rework or integration failures (baseline not yet established)
qualified customer conversations and verified outcomes
requested_deliverables: GTM experiment proposal with measurable hypotheses
